                   id, project_id, issue_id, jira_key, mr_url, mr_number,
                   comment_kind, comment_id, author, is_bot, body, path, line,
                   commented_at
               )
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
               ON CONFLICT(project_id, mr_number, comment_kind, comment_id)
               DO NOTHING
